metadata.title: Schwarz Lemma in Quaternionic Setting and $\mathbb C^4$
metadata.abstract: We study a Schwarz Lemma on the matrix ball \[ \mathbb D^+=\{Z\in M_2(\mathbb C);\, \|Z\|<1\} \simeq U(2,2)/(U(2)\times U(2)), \] which arises naturally from the complexification of the quaternions. We prove Schwarz and Schwarz--Pick estimates on $\mathbb D^+$, construct its $U(2,2)$-invariant Riemannian Poincaré metric, and describe a Cayley transform to a tube-domain realization. The intrinsic spectral metric is the Kobayashi metric and is contracted by holomorphic maps. Comparing it with the Poincaré metric gives the sharp estimate $d(F(P),F(Q))\le \sqrt2\,d(P,Q)$ for every holomorphic self-map $F$ of $\mathbb D^+$; in general the constant $1$ is false. We also prove an infinitesimal rigidity statement and record a Burns--Krantz boundary rigidity theorem at the smooth part of $\partial\mathbb D^+$. Finally, we develop a conformally natural barycenter construction on the Shilov boundary $U(2)$. Every admissible probability measure has a unique barycenter in $\mathbb D^+$, the construction is $U(2,2)$-natural, and it gives a barycentric extension of suitable boundary maps. Under the natural admissibility hypothesis, a holomorphic self-map extending to $U(2)$ is the barycentric extension of its boundary values. Many aspects of this paper are motivated by quaternionic analysis, however, no prior knowledge of quaternionic analysis is required from the reader.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 矩阵球的尖锐Schwarz估计与重心
analysis.workSummary: 在D⁺={Z∈M₂(C):||Z||<1}≃U(2,2)/(U(2)×U(2))上证明Schwarz/Schwarz–Pick估计，构造不变Riemannian Poincaré度量及管域Cayley模型。内蕴谱度量等于Kobayashi度量并被全纯映射压缩；比较得到每个全纯自映射对Poincaré距离满足d(FP,FQ)≤√2d(P,Q)，常数尖锐且一般不能改为1。还给无穷小及光滑边界部分的Burns–Krantz刚性，并在Shilov边界U(2)上为每个admissible概率测度构造唯一、U(2,2)自然的重心，产生边界映射延拓。
analysis.breakthrough: 精确区分矩阵球的两种度量收缩常数，并建立相容的自然重心延拓。
analysis.limitations: Poincaré度量的一般收缩常数是√2，不能移用Kobayashi的1；重心唯一性及全纯映射等于边界重心延拓均需admissibility，边界刚性限光滑边界部分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: Use of artificial intelligence明确ChatGPT-5提供轻度编辑，并辅助第8、9节中8.2之后的大多数应用；明确这些应用的总体主题及第8节以前的原始内容归作者。已对照8.2谱度量收缩、8.3尖锐Lipschitz、8.4刚性和第9节重心方法的编排，按数学应用论证辅助和文字记，不声称模型提出具体核心思想或将所有前文归AI。作者独立核验的责任说明不转成AI verification。
